name: RescueBench
summary: 基于 Unreal Engine 的开放世界搜救具身智能基准，提供多阶段任务、渐进难度和专家轨迹采集工具。
summaryEn: An Unreal Engine open-world search-and-rescue benchmark with multi-stage tasks, progressive difficulty, and expert-trajectory collection tools.
scale: Four-stage benchmark; approximately 400K expert steps planned
scaleZh: 四阶段基准；计划发布约 40 万专家步骤
licenseZh: 代码采用 Apache-2.0；数据许可待公布
access: Benchmark environment and trajectory collection tools available; dataset release planned
accessZh: 基准环境和轨迹采集工具可用，数据发布仍在计划中
verdict: 可生成具身搜救交互轨迹的多阶段开放世界环境
verdictEn: A multi-stage open-world environment capable of generating embodied rescue trajectories
wmNote: 顺序依赖任务适合研究长期规划、状态转移和错误恢复。
wmNoteEn: Sequentially dependent tasks support research on long-horizon planning, transitions, and recovery.

evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - UnrealZoo/RescueBench: RescueBench is a search-and-rescue (SAR) benchmark designed for embodied AI, built on Unreal Engine and UnrealZoo. It offers a standardized framework for evaluating AI models in open-world scenarios, featuring multi-stage assessments and progressive difficulty levels. · GitHub
evidence.statement: Gym-like interface exposes first-person observations, navigation/interaction actions and rewards; README explicitly provides expert-trajectory collection tools.
